messages:
alex.k: incident-bot just paged: Request error spike for /v1/generate in us-west-2 — 5xx rate up from 0.2% to 12% (avg latency 450ms). I'm looking now.
incident-bot: [ALERT] 1855007777 - High 5xx rate - /v1/generate - us-west-2 - severity:high - triggered by error-budget-rule (avg 12% over 5m).
maya.oncall: oncall here, pulling up logs. tagging @devops for infra visibility.
sara.prod: noticed elevated retry traffic from a few customers, might be upstream gateway timeouts.
alex.k: stack trace shows transient redis timeouts hitting kv-cache fallback in the runtime. ran `kubectl logs -l app=inference --since=10m` — a few pods show OOMKill spikes.
devops: seeing node memory pressure around 13:04 UTC, autoscaler didn't spin new nodes because of quota error. I opened a ticket with cloud quota team.
maya.oncall: mitigation in progress: draining a couple of bad pods and scaling down heavy batch workers, routing to standby pool. Executing: `routing set-priority --route /v1/generate --pool standby`
jamal: pushed a temporary fallback policy in the router: 1) route 10% to smaller model variant 2) enable client rate-limiter 3) reduce batch size to 8.
cleo: adding a prefix-cache bypass for affected requests so they don't trigger large KV loads.
alex.k: logs showing successful reduction in 5xx after routing change, error rate dropped to ~3% in 3m.
incident-bot: [UPDATE] 1855007890 - Mitigations applied: routing fallback + node drain. Error rate trending down.
maya.oncall: handing off to afternoon oncall @jamal for stabilization and post-incident follow-up. jamal, you have control.
jamal: got it. I'll keep monitoring 30m then schedule postmortem. Can someone collect customer impact list?
sara.prod: pulling customer telemetry now. Initial list: two high-volume tenants saw increased latency and some 5xx retries between 13:02-13:12 UTC. I'll post numbers.
ryan-finance: tagging finance to flag potential SLA credits — please add rough hit estimate when you have it (@ryan-finance).
jamal: agreed. Action items: 1) root-cause analysis for autoscaler quota miss (owner: devops) 2) review memory usage patterns on batch workers (owner: eng-runtime) 3) validate canary fallback policy (owner: product-ops) 4) customer impact doc + SLA impact calc (owner: sara.prod) 5) billing/SLA credit follow-up (owner: ryan-finance).
cleo: noted. I'll set up a short reproducer job for KV loads.
alex.k: temporary workaround timeline: 13:05–13:20 UTC. Will include in postmortem.
jamal: scheduling postmortem — propose 1855012000 (iso: 2026-04-02T15:00:00Z) in #incident-postmortems. Can everyone add availability?
sara.prod: available, will bring customer telemetry + logs.
devops: available, will bring autoscaler/cloud quota ticket and node logs.
maya.oncall: I'm free to attend handoff recap.
ryan-finance: can't make that time, but I'll sync separately. I'll need the customer impact table and per-customer uptime delta to compute credits.
alex.k: here's a quick impact summary for finance: tenant A (high-volume) saw 10 minutes of degraded success and 20% increased retries = ~550K extra tokens processed; tenant B (mid) saw 6 minutes degraded = ~120K extra tokens. These are rough — sara will confirm.
ryan-finance: thanks, that helps. For SLA credits we'll need: 1) precise downtime window per tenant, 2) SLA tier, 3) usage baseline for billing period. Please attach CSV of per-tenant token counts and error rates.
sara.prod: I'll export a CSV and drop in the postmortem thread, plus a query snippet for reproducibility:
```
SELECT tenant_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens, SUM(errors) as errors, MIN(ts) as start, MAX(ts) as end
FROM request_metrics
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-04-02T13:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-02T13:30:00Z'
AND route = '/v1/generate'
GROUP BY tenant_id;
```
jamal: good. Also tagging governance for SLA/contract review: @cleo please confirm if any enterprise deals have special indemnities.
cleo: checked — two customers have enterprise SLAs with 99.9% uptime and credit rules in contract appendix B. We'll need legal review before final comms.
incident-bot: [POSTMORTEM] 1855012000 - Postmortem scheduled for incident 1855007777 in #incident-postmortems.
alex.k: can someone draft the initial postmortem doc skeleton? I'll start the timeline and mitigation steps.
sara.prod: I'll add customer impact + CSV. devops please paste autoscaler error and quota ticket ID.
devops: quota ticket #Q-5423 opened with cloud support, they confirmed limit flapped; root cause likely a delayed quota refresh after recent infra changes. Ticket link: https://cloud.example.com/tickets/Q-5423
ryan-finance: once we have the per-tenant downtime and usage delta, I'll calculate tentative credit amounts and propose an accounting entry. Also need confirmation whether credits come from usage refunds or separate SLA credit line (depends on contract).
jamal: timeline for remediation: 1) autoscaler fix and test by 2026-04-03 EOD (devops) 2) batch worker memory cap + alerts updated by 2026-04-04 (eng-runtime) 3) fallback policies codified + canary tests by 2026-04-05 (product-ops) 4) final postmortem + customer comms by 2026-04-06 (jamal/sara).
maya.oncall: adding a short runbook note to incident-runbooks: ensure quota check in autoscaler startup path.
cleo: legal will review customer language, aim to be ready for comms after postmortem.
sara.prod: CSV uploaded to the postmortem thread: https://redwood.internal/pm/1855007777/impact.csv (contains per-tenant tokens/errors/times).
ryan-finance: received CSV, will run credit calc. Preliminary estimate: $8.2k in refundable usage and $1.5k in SLA credit for enterprise customers pending contract confirmation. Will confirm after legal check.
alex.k: thanks all. jamal, keep this thread updated with postmortem link and any customer comms drafts.
jamal: will do. closing oncall handoff. If anyone sees regression, page me immediately. :triangular_flag_on_post:
